description: Rasterize PDF pages as PNG or JPG at a chosen DPI. Useful for previews, OCR pipelines, or feeding pages back to a vision model.

basename.description: Stem for output filenames. Default = source filename without .pdf. Final names: '<basename>-001.png' (page number padded to 3 digits).

dpi.description: Render resolution. Default 150. PDF native is 72; common values: 96 screen, 150 print preview, 300 print.

format.description: Output format. Default "png". "jpg" is smaller but lossy.

jpgQuality.description: JPEG quality 40-100. Default 85. Ignored for PNG.

outputDir.description: Directory to write the rendered images into.

pages.description: 1-based page range, e.g. "3", "1-5", "1,3,5-7". Omit for all pages.

path.description: Absolute path to the source PDF.

name: to_images
title: Render pages to images
